final: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM funding_counts), paired AS (SELECT f.funding_source, f.record_count, 1.0 * f.record_count / t.total_count AS share FROM funding_counts AS f JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM paired) SELECT p.funding_source, p.record_count, p.share, p.record_count - a.average_count AS count_above_average FROM paired AS p JOIN averages AS a ON a.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE p.record_count > a.average_count
